name: Business Brain Showa-Ota Inc.
summary: Business Brain Showa-Ota Inc. provides consulting and systems development, and business management services in Japan. The company provides accounting package, enterprise solutions, digital transformation (DX), business-specific and industry-specific services, product-specific templates, HR and payroll solutions, and payment solutions. It also offers BPO solutions in the field of accounting, finance, human resources (HR), and payroll. In addition, the company provides management accounting consulting services for HR and organization, business planning and management, formulation of design for consolidated management foundation, system consulting, RPA/BA, merger and acquisition, implementation…
